thread:
Arjun: Quick sync — post-launch signal on snippet rewrite: some customers seeing the model confidently inventing facts in short rewrites. Need a triage decision: hot heuristic patch + canary or queue for a quality sprint?

Jen: Can you quantify impact? sessions/day / customer surface?

Arjun: Telemetry: ~120k rewrite sessions/day, ~0.4% (~480) flagged by our QA heuristics. Top affected tenants: Appify, NovaCorp. No crashes, purely hallucinated content in snippets. Sample (sanitized):
```
rewrite_id=01f3a sample_input="Acme revenue grew 20%" sample_output="Acme acquired BetaCorp in 2024"
```

Mike: Thanks — my instinct is quick patch + canary. Heuristic: if model_confidence < 0.6 or source_overlap < 0.2, return original snippet. Small dev effort (~2h) + 1 day canary.

Sara: Agree on the approach but watch latency. If we call model and then fallback, that'll add RT. Could do a prefilter that checks for low-overlap tokens and short-circuits before full generation.

Jen: Also weigh customer SLA and comms. Appify is tier-2 and has flagged it. If we can get a fast canary, we should. This should be in roadmap tradeoffs doc — will affect the follow-on milestone for "snippets 2.0".

Tom-S: From infra side we can add a canary route: service/search-rewrite-canary. Ops-bot can kick it. No infra blockers.

ops-bot: deploy:start service=search-rewrite-canary version=hotfix-2026-03-21 :rocket:

Arjun: Proposed decision: implement confidence-based fallback + prefilter, canary to 10% for 48h, monitor content-fidelity/regression metrics; if green, roll to 100% next week. Any objections?

Jen: +1. Add a small eval set for "content fidelity" and a regression alert if fidelity drops >1% from baseline. Also prepare a one-paragraph note for Appify support.

Mike: I’ll own the patch. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Will include the prefilter and fallback.

Sara: I’ll add perf instrumentation: p50/p95 for rewrite path, and an alert if p95 increases >30ms. Also add a metric for fallback rate.

Tom-S: I’ll wire up the canary policy and set rollout to 10% for 48h, then manual review.

Arjun: Action items: Mike implement patch; Sara perf + alerts; Jen stakeholder comms; Tom add canary policy; Ops-bot trigger. Reconvene Fri 10am to review metrics. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Jen: FYI I'll message Appify support lead and share expected timeline.

Mike: Quick note — test cases I’ll add: one for false positives (should not fallback) and a small prompt-set for hallucination regressions.

Sara: Adding dashboard link in a sec.

ops-bot: deploy:success service=search-rewrite-canary version=hotfix-2026-03-21 :white_check_mark:
